name: brock-screenplays
description: Private marketplace for the screenplay production-prep engine.

plugins.name: screenplay-prep
plugins.description: Reusable production-prep engine for feature screenplays: read-only audit agents (continuity, motif, slugline, cast-cue, fact-drift, fidelity, structure, dialogue, rights, pitch) plus reconcile / casting-doc / cast-report / paged-HTML / fdx-convert scripts and eight workflow skills. Project-parameterized — each screenplay supplies a PROJECT_PROFILE.md the agents and scripts read.
